---
name: New library request
about: Suggest a new shape library or a set of shapes to add
title: "[Library Request] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What should this library cover?**
A clear, narrow scope — see the "Adding a New Library" guidelines in CATALOG.md.
e.g. "Terraform provider icons" or "Sequence diagram notation".

**Why is this useful?**
What kind of diagrams would this help with?

**Reference material**
Links to existing icon sets, notation standards, or examples (if any). Note that
this repo doesn't redistribute vendor-trademarked icon artwork — see
`aws-services.xml` / `gcp-services.xml` for the kind of original, non-trademarked
treatment used for cloud provider icons.

**Are you able to contribute this yourself?**
- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR
- [ ] No, just suggesting it
